title: Quantitative Assessment of Crystal Structure Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.10380v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Crystal Structure Prediction (CSP) aims to predict a material's 3D structure from its chemical composition, with applications from energy storage to biomedical devices. Despite its importance, existing evaluation frameworks suffer from key limitations: they rely on threshold-sensitive or incomparable metrics, focus predominantly on geometric performance while overlooking physical plausibility, and fail to account for polymorphism, where a chemical composition can crystallize into multiple stable structures. In parallel, recent Symmetry-Informed CSP (SICSP) methods often report results alongside standard CSP baselines while receiving crystallographic templates at inference, which constrain the search space and make SICSP a fundamentally different task. To address these limitations, we introduce an Orientation-invariant, Polymorph-Aware, Large Benchmark (OPAL-Bench) that evaluates CSP and SICSP as separate tasks. We evaluate 7 CS

translated_title: 晶体结构预测的定量评估
translated_abstract: 晶体结构预测（CSP）旨在根据材料的化学成分预测其三维结构，应用领域涵盖从储能到生物医学设备等多个方面。尽管其重要性显著，现有的评估框架存在几个关键局限：它们依赖于对阈值敏感或不可比较的指标，主要关注几何性能而忽视了物理合理性，并且未能考虑多晶型现象——即同一种化学成分可以结晶成多种稳定结构。与此同时，近期的对称性信息驱动晶体结构预测（SICSP）方法通常与标准CSP基线一起报告结果，但它们在推理阶段接收晶体学模板，这限制了搜索空间，使SICSP成为一项本质上不同的任务。为了解决这些局限，我们引入了一个方向不变、多晶型感知的大型基准（OPAL-Bench），将CSP和SICSP作为两个独立任务进行评估。我们评估了7种CSP方法（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个方向不变、多晶型感知的大型基准OPAL-Bench，将晶体结构预测（CSP）与对称性信息驱动的CSP（SICSP）区分为两个独立任务进行定量评估，解决了现有评估框架中指标不可比、忽视物理合理性与多晶型现象等关键局限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces OPAL-Bench, the first orientation-invariant, polymorph-aware large benchmark that evaluates Crystal Structure Prediction (CSP) and Symmetry-Informed CSP (SICSP) as separate tasks, addressing key limitations of existing evaluation frameworks such as threshold-sensitive metrics, overlooked physical plausibility, and unaccounted polymorphism.
